title: AuthFrame

token.description: The client session token from /api/pair or /api/bootstrap. It never travels in a URL.

protocolVersion.description: A wire protocol version: one integer, bumped only on a breaking change.

clientKind.description: What kind of client a client session belongs to: the desktop window, the terminal UI, a browser tab, or a program (a script or bot driving the wire).

description: From the client, first: its client session token, protocol version, kind and harness version.
